recommendation: Provide patient education and self-care support for heart failure patients
implementation_steps: Reinforce self-care education, including daily weights, symptom recognition, and action plans for decompensation
Lead patient and caregiver education, focusing on skill-building for medication management
Teach dietary adherence strategies, particularly sodium restriction techniques
Train patients on early symptom reporting and when to seek medical attention
Monitor and support adherence to self-care behaviors through regular follow-up
evidence_summary: Nurse-led patient education and self-care support interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in heart failure self-care behaviors, quality of life, and reduced hospitalizations across multiple randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses.
citation: Effects of Self-Management Interventions on Heart Failure: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
